SUNOG SA BRGY. PASONG PUTIK, QUEZON CITY

PANOORIN: Sunog sa residential area sa Bautista Street, Brgy. Pasong Putik, Quezon City, itinaas na sa ikatlong alarma, ayon sa BFP-NCR, May 13, 2026.

Nagsimula ang sunog pasado 1 AM ng madaling araw. Mabilis na kumalat ang apoy sa magkakadikit na bahay. | via James Agustin/GMA News
Video Courtesy: Adrian Tobias

data.english_translation: IN BRGY. THE PUTIK, Quezon City TOOORIN: Fire at the residential area on Baptist Street, Brgy., Quezon City, raised at the third alarm, according to BFP-NCR, May 13, 2026. Fire began just as soon as 1 AM of the morning. The fire spread through closely joined houses.ult James VIBAN/GMA News Videoies: Adrian Tobias

𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐟𝐟𝐢𝐜 𝐀𝐝𝐯𝐢𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐲

On Tuesday, May 19, 2026, and Wednesday, May 20, 2026, the United States Navy Blue Angels Practice and Air Show will be held in Annapolis.

These events will affect traffic along the following roadways:  

• The Exit 27 ramp of Route 50 onto southbound MD 450 (Baltimore/Naval Academy) will be closed.

• The Naval Academy Bridge will be closed. Expect significant traffic delays on MD-450 and MD-648 south of US-50. Access to Pendennis Mount, Greenbury Point, and the Naval Support Activity will be limited.

• Southbound MD-450 traffic will be detoured northbound at the World War II Memorial. Southbound MD-648 (B&A Blvd) traffic will be detoured at Greenbury Point Rd and will not have access to MD-450.
